run_lint_session: run pre-commit lint checks on all files in the pybind11 codebase
run_tests_session: run pybind11 test suite with cmake across multiple Python versions
run_packaging_tests: run pytest on the extra_python_package directory for packaging validation
build_docs_session: build HTML or PDF documentation using Sphinx and optionally serve locally
build_wheels_session: build SDists and wheels for pybind11 including global SDIST variant
